description: Melbourne drain and waterway outlets is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. This data contains points representing drain and waterway outlet locations, associated with a natural waterway or channel centreline, within the Greater Melbourne region. This region includes the Port Phillip Bay and Western Port coastlines. Points are captured to show the indicative location of the endpoint for a waterway or channel as geographic coordinates. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Melbourne Water Open Data Hub. Its tags are agriculture, assets, hydrology, infrastructure, irrigation. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
